title: Hearth of the Veil
shortDescription: Silver curtains keep half the room in honest shadow.
longDescription:
The Hearth of the Veil is quieter than its neighbours. Pale curtains take the light and give it back in pieces. A tall dark mirror stands where a first-year will want to look too long. The floor is worn in a path that does not go straight.
Mentor Mist does not fill the silence. She uses it.

fixtures.name: Mentor Mist
fixtures.lookDescription: A pale ermine in a silver-grey cloak, one eye kept in shadow. Try talk mist.
fixtures.examineDescription: Mist's fur is almost white. The cloak drinks sound. She watches the end of a sentence, not the start of it.
fixtures.dialogue: "The Veil is a craft of what is not said. Look this hearth. Find Flint. Come back."

welcome.text: "I am Mist. The Veil teaches you to notice what a room is hiding. Look this hearth. Walk to the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Return and talk to me."

craft.text: "Not every true thing should be spoken in the open. First you learn to see. Then you learn to strike a thing that is meant to be struck. Then you come back, and we will see what you noticed."

go.text: "Look the mirror. Then find the orchard. I will still be here."

fixtures.name: Dark Mirror
fixtures.examineDescription: The glass does not flatter. It shows the room behind you more clearly than the face in front. A slate says: 'Name what moved.'
